acceptance_evidence: GitHub Actions checks on the implementation PR
completion_conditions: A refused carry appears in mergegate-result.json blocking_reasons with the evaluator's reason, so shiki_loop._resolve_blocking_reasons carries it into the repair packet and handoff.
A proven carry is disclosed as a fact about the carry and never as an approval claim, so a PR blocked for a missing label is not told its approval was carried.
The gate and the CCA signal name the same carry refusal over the same repository state, pinned by a regression test.
With --base-sync-carry absent the gate output is byte-identical to the pre-carry gate.
non_goals: Re-anchoring the step-9 tree reproduction to the merged base instead of the live origin/<default_branch> tip; that amends SADR-0018 and inverts test_superseded_stale_base_passes_arity_refused_by_step9.
Any change to shiki_sync_proof.py, shiki_guardian.py, the workflow YAML, or mergegate_check.py argv.
Disclosure in shiki_guardian_status.py, a separate operator-facing surface with its own tests.
outcome: The MergeGate policy check states whether a base-sync carry was proven or refused, and when refused states the evaluator's reason, so an approved CCA Guardian signal against a blocked authoritative gate is diagnosable from durable gate evidence rather than by hand-reading job logs.
title: MergeGate discloses the SADR-0018 base-sync carry outcome
